title: Horizontal Channel Upholstered Kids Bed – Children's Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Horizontal Channel Kids Bed has evenly spaced horizontal channels across the headboard. The look is calmer and more linear than our fan or panel designs, and the bed is fully upholstered and handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Evenly spaced horizontal channel headboard
  • Fully upholstered enclosed side panels and matching footboard
  • Solid, sturdy frame
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £299.00; Small Double (4FT) £299.00; Kids Single (2.6FT) £299.00. Not sure which size or mattress to choose? Call 07417 439197 before you order, or browse our mattresses.

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a solid, sturdy wood frame that is fully upholstered. Available in a wide range of colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Which kids bed has the calmest look?

The Horizontal Channel Kids Bed has the most linear look of our kids designs.

What sizes does the Horizontal Channel Kids Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT) and Kids Single (2.6FT).

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
